decisions: Preserve ground/RESOURCE_LEDGER.json as the canonical current projection and widen it to every resource class.
Keep capacity, lifecycle stage, condition, and authority independent.
Treat Bryce as a constrained producing resource and reserve owner attention for irreducibly owner-only acts.
Keep Cursor held until explicit release and Claude suspended pending clarification; Claude never gains tester, verifier, reviewer, or landing authority.
Do not resend the eight delivered revenue contacts.
Do not mutate the Titan model artifact until its canonical span and recovery packet are owner-approved.
Do not install latent plugins without an explicit request for a named plugin and concrete task.
Represent duplicated repository content as aliases and lineage; do not delete historical or quarantined paths.
